Name: Meadow Farm Style Tractor and Garage (CP)
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[size=4]A restyling of Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url], designed to coordinate with the look of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url]'s Mountain Meadow Farm house and other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/search?keyword=meadow+farm+style]Meadow Farm Style[/url] mods. Included are four Tractor recolors and two Garage styles to use with the Tractor Mod.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Download and install/unzip the [CP] file into your mods folder. Once installed, any existing or newly constructed tractor garage should have this style. If you have other Content Patcher tractor/garage mods installed, you may need to select this one specifically, disable the others in the Generic Mod Config Menu or remove them from your mods folder. 

[i]Customization options in the Generic Mod Config Menu:
[/i][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select to disable/enable this mod if you want to mix and match with other building textures. Default setting is selected/enabled.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tractor Color: Choose between Red, Gold, Green or Light.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Garage Style: Choose between Windows Outside or Windows Inside.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tractor Mod[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits and appreciation: [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lemurkat/East Scarp Remastered for the cool look of the Mountain Meadow Farm house that this is based on and permission to use it as inspiration.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Pathoschild/Tractor Mod for the base mod assets used in this mod and the helpful modification documentation.[/color]
